prompt: The first attached image is the approved model sheet of Diana with the nose accessory of this scene: copy her face and that accessory EXACTLY (the same object, the same size relative to her face, the same position on the bridge of the nose and the same diagonal angle). Draw the rest of her body as a real white cat with the same flat style. The attached images are the official character portraits: keep each character's design, colors, markings and accessories exactly as in their portrait (the portraits only show the head; draw the rest of the body to match). Ignore any badge, medallion or hexagon frame around a portrait: it is not part of the character. A single comic-book panel from the cozy story mode of the game Dice Duel. It must look like the game's own art, the attached character art: a flat sticker illustration with a thick uniform dark cocoa outline (#3a2a2e) around every shape, flat color fills with ONE soft cel-shaded shadow tone and one small highlight, no gradients, no glow, no painterly texture, no realistic lighting, no 3D rendering. Only the game's palette: cream paper #fbf1df and #f1dfc2, ivory #fffaf0, sage felt greens #4e7d68 and #5f8f78, wood browns #7a4b2f and #a86c45, honey #f2b15e, coral #e8806f, rose #ec8fa8, sky blue #6fbfd3, lavender #b8a4f0, mint #8fd6a8, cocoa #3a2a2e. Backgrounds are SIMPLE: a few big flat color shapes (a wall, a floor, a window) with at most three props, no clutter, no decorative plants or mugs unless the scene asks for them. Cozy, adult, dry humor; expressive faces, not chibi, not childish. No halftone dots (they are added later), no panel border, no frame, no gutter, no white margin: the art fills the image edge to edge. No speech balloons, no captions, no sound effects and no lettering, except a sign the scene explicitly asks for. Every die is a plain six-sided cube with round pips, in its owner's color (Diana's are pink). Draw few dice, and every visible face with a correct standard pip layout: 1 = one center pip; 2 = two pips on a diagonal; 3 = three pips on a diagonal; 4 = four corners; 5 = four corners and the center; 6 = two parallel rows of three. Never more than six pips on a face, never a blank face, and two faces of the same die never show numbers that add up to 7. DIANA: a white domestic cat with cool white fur (not cream, not yellow), clear light-blue eyes; the upper third of the ear on the VIEWER'S LEFT is solid black, the other ear is all white with pink inside; exactly TWO short vertical charcoal-gray stripes in the middle of her forehead; faint light-gray shading above the eyes; small pink nose, white whiskers. She has real cat proportions (four paws, no clothes); only her expressions are human: dry, confident, a little conspiratorial. Over the bridge of Diana's nose: TWO small cream adhesive bandages crossed in an X. SCENE: Diana sits at her felt table and holds a damp notebook page up in front of her face with both front paws, reading it with narrowed eyes. The page faces HER: we see only the plain cream BACK of the page, blank, with a faint wet stain showing through, and NOTHING drawn on the side we see (no tadpole, no writing). Her eyes peek over the top edge of the page. Behind her, only the edge of a cork board shows at the side of the frame.
